author: smcarus
title: Do financial sanctions change a target country's macro path, or only its routes?
summary: Argue whether broad financial sanctions measurably change a target economy's growth, inflation and reserves, or mainly reroute trade and payments. Use the app's sanctions tools, official series and cited studies.
positions: They mostly reroute trade and payments
It depends on the target's commodity exports
knownLimits: Official data for sanctioned countries are sparse and sometimes withheld; say when a figure is Missing.
